newsitem.title: JAPAN: Toyota"s Spacio exceeds sales target.
newsitem.headline: Toyota"s Spacio exceeds sales target.

text.p: Toyota Motor Corp said on Tuesday it has received 14,000 domestic orders for its new Corolla Spacio compact multi-purpose vehicle in the first month of sales.
On January 13, Japan"s top carmaker launched the Corolla Spacio in Japan with a monthly sales target of 5,000 units with price starting at 1.57 million yen.
Toyota president Hiroshi Okuda said in January he expected domestic orders for 10,000 Spacios in the first month.
A competitive price, unique detachable seat and standard equipment safety devices such as dual airbags and an anti-lock brake system contributed to the large demand, the spokesman said.
